start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj hum perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangle, square ya polygon mein se kaunsa shape pasand hai?

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh sunna bahut bhaari lag raha hai. Aap abhi theek aur safe hain?

turns.line: main theek hoon, bas thak gaya
turns.reply: Kabir, break lijiye; jo baat pareshaan kare, trusted adult ko batayiye. Lesson yahin rukta hai—lautkar perimeter se shuru karenge.
